contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Created the game design and original Lantern Reach setting; directed the production of Jump-1.

contributions.name: Nilo / Codex
contributions.summary: Implemented the engine, interface, audio and integrations under Cédric Bernadac’s direction. Refreshed layouts and native Blender faces in 0.2; added destination briefings, scene guidance, reports and motion in 0.3. Added contextual voyages, crew assistance, compact inspections, branching starts, ship fittings, market requests and linked stories in 0.4, preserving legacy saves.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1
contributions.summary: Created original Blender models, materials and image renders, including the native HD ship cutaway, under Cédric Bernadac's direction. Refined the 16 crew portraits and four inhabited port/bar scenes for the 0.2.0 visual refresh.

contributions.name: Claude Opus 5.5
contributions.summary: Added the first-voyage guide, the crew and port explanations, and the draggable star chart in 0.1.2, under Cédric Bernadac's direction. Added rules edition 5 in 0.5.0: economy fixes, early loan settlement, a working-capital advance, working port orders, bill, payment and repair previews, selling from the market, a French text pass and accessibility fixes, preserving 0.3 and 0.4 saves.
